name: shilp-sutra-smoke-consumer
description: Consumer-side smoke test for @devalok/shilp-sutra. Simulates what Karm (and any TW4 Next.js consumer) does — pnpm packs core, installs the tarball, imports a representative surface of components, runs next build with Turbopack. Any dist-side bug (Node-only imports, TW3 class leftovers, theme() calls, etc.) that a real consumer would hit surfaces here.
